en_title: Capcom Celebrates Record Sales in First Half of 2027 Fiscal Year, With Overwhelming Majority Being Digital Purchases
cn_title: 卡普空半财年销量破纪录，数字版占九成
subtitle: 老游戏仍是主力
opus_summary: 卡普空2027财年上半年游戏总销量及旧作销量均创同期纪录，数字版占92.4%。《怪物猎人：世界》《生化危机2》重制版和《生化危机7》位列畅销榜前三。

paragraphs.en: Capcom is celebrating its highest software unit sales for the first half of a fiscal year in the company’s 47-year history, with games like Monster Hunter World, Resident Evil 2, and RE7 Biohazard leading the fray.
paragraphs.cn: 卡普空迎来了公司成立47年来最高的上半财年游戏销量，《怪物猎人：世界》《生化危机2》和《生化危机7》等作品领跑。

paragraphs.en: It’s safe to say that 2026 was a hugely successful year for Capcom, and its next fiscal year is already looking just as rosy. In the 2026 calendar year, the developer launched three Game of the Year contenders in Resident Evil Requiem , the new but ambitious Pragmata , and Onimusha: Way of the Sword , all of which were met with critical acclaim.
paragraphs.cn: 可以说，卡普空在2026年取得了巨大成功，而下一个财年的前景看起来同样光明。在2026自然年，卡普空推出了三款有望角逐年度游戏的作品：《生化危机：安魂曲》、全新且颇具野心的《识质存在》，以及《鬼武者：剑之道》。这三款游戏都获得了媒体好评。

paragraphs.en: These recent titles aren’t responsible for making up the bulk of its profits for its current fiscal year, though. Instead, older titles like Monster Hunter World (a live-service game that released in 2018), Resident Evil 2 Remake (2019), and Resident Evil 7: BioHazard (2017) took the top three spots in its top ten best-selling titles for the first half of its 2027 fiscal year.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，卡普空本财年的大部分利润并非来自这些新作。相反，2018年发售的持续运营游戏《怪物猎人：世界》、2019年发售的《生化危机2》重制版，以及2017年发售的《生化危机7》等老游戏，占据了公司2027财年上半年十大畅销游戏榜的前三名。

paragraphs.en: Given their popularity and prestige, it’s not a massive surprise that these three titles continue to do gangbusters for Capcom almost a decade after their release. For example, in July, Resident Evil 2 Remake officially dethroned Resident Evil 5 as the series’ best-selling game at 19.75 million copies sold — a number that, as of Capcom’s latest public financial report, has increased by 2.06 million to sit at 20.38 million total copies sold.
paragraphs.cn: 考虑到这三款游戏的人气和口碑，它们在发售近十年后依然为卡普空贡献亮眼销量，并不太令人意外。例如，今年7月，《生化危机2》重制版以1,975万份的销量正式超越《生化危机5》，成为系列最畅销作品。根据卡普空最新公开的财报，这一数字又增加了206万份，累计销量达到2,038万份。

paragraphs.en: Monster Hunter World takes the cake far and away, though, sitting at 30.83 million units sold at a 1.17 million increase. RE 7 takes third place at 20.38 million units, with a 2.06 million unit increase.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，《怪物猎人：世界》遥遥领先，销量增加117万份，累计达到3,083万份。《生化危机7》位居第三，销量增加206万份，累计达到2,038万份。

paragraphs.en: It's worth noting that the newest Monster Hunter entry, Monster Hunter Wilds , isn't listed on here. However, the previous game in the series is still a juggernaut for Capcom, going to show just how unpopular Wilds is following oodles of player complaints in the year since it's February 2025 launch... and that's even after Capcom 'permanently' slashed the game's price .
paragraphs.cn: 值得注意的是，《怪物猎人》系列最新作《怪物猎人：荒野》并未上榜。相比之下，系列前作依然是卡普空的销量主力，也足见《怪物猎人：荒野》有多不受欢迎：自2025年2月发售后的一年里，玩家对它怨声载道……即便卡普空已将游戏「永久」大幅降价，情况依然如此。

paragraphs.en: According to Capcom's financial report , these figures mark the company's highest-ever total and catalog unit sales for an H1 period, and most of them were digital. This same report shows that a staggering 92.4% of sales were digital, with 57.1% coming from PC and 35.3% from consoles. In stark comparison, physical units make up just 7.6% of sales. (This is actually a bit of a drop from its previously reported digital sales figures back in Q1 2026, which was listed at 93.3%.)
paragraphs.cn: 卡普空财报显示，公司游戏总销量和旧作销量均创下上半财年的历史纪录，其中绝大多数来自数字版。同一份财报显示，数字版销量占比高达92.4%，其中PC占总销量的57.1%，主机占35.3%。相比之下，实体版仅占总销量的7.6%，差距鲜明。（不过，数字版占比其实比此前公布的2026年第一季度数据略有下降，当时为93.3%。）

paragraphs.en: This all comes hot off the heels of Capcom’s two newest film adaptations, with Zach Cregger’s Resident Evil movie becoming the most profitable in the series’ history and Street Fighter launching to number one at the box office during its opening weekend ( news of a sequel , however, is still up in the air).
paragraphs.cn: 就在这些消息公布前不久，卡普空旗下两部最新改编电影也传来捷报：Zach Cregger执导的《生化危机》成为系列史上盈利最高的电影，《街头霸王》则在首映周末登顶票房榜（不过，是否会有续集仍未确定）。

paragraphs.en: Pragmata also performed well for Capcom, with corporate officer Yoshikazu Shimauchi suggesting that sales were so good that the likelihood of a sequel is high . Combine that with Onimusha selling one million copies on day one , it’s clear that 2026 is Capcom’s year. Now, we just need to see how The Game Awards pan out.
paragraphs.cn: 《识质存在》也为卡普空交出了亮眼成绩。公司执行官Yoshikazu Shimauchi暗示，游戏销量十分出色，推出续作的可能性很高。再加上《鬼武者：剑之道》首日销量突破100万份，显然，2026年属于卡普空。现在，就看游戏大奖的结果如何了。
